summary: Iteration 104: Verified theme persistence and test account seed data fixes. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: theme saves with POST (not PUT), theme syncs on login via syncThemeFromBackend(), test account has comprehensive seed data (assets, loans, CCs, insurance).
